name: production boundary: a deploy split by backslash-underscore in env's -S string inside a double-quoted eval payload is denied unread

source.assertion:
assert_equals "a deploy split by backslash-underscore in env's -S string inside a double-quoted eval payload is denied unread" \
  "deny" "$(verdict_for \"eval \"env -S 'vercel\\_--prod'\"\")"

contains: past what the production boundary can read
